description: Webhook Signature Verifier API: Verify Stripe, GitHub, Slack, Shopify, and Svix HMAC webhook signatures and timestamps. (Endpoint: POST /v1/webhook-verify)

now_epoch_seconds.description: Optional reference Unix timestamp in seconds (defaults to current time).

provider.description: Webhook provider signature scheme to verify.

raw_body.description: Exact raw HTTP request body string (must not be re-serialized).

secret.description: Webhook signing secret (or omit from body and pass via X-Tinplate-Signing-Secret header; processed strictly in memory, never logged).

tolerance_seconds.description: Maximum allowed timestamp age in seconds for timestamped schemes (default 300; 0 disables).

name: tinplate_webhook_verify
